reading: A ceiling that stops only the closure child while the parent survives was not found on this cell: the trivial cell needs about 300 MB of virtual memory in total, and below that the parent dies at import time, before any record. That path is a terminal invalid stop (the remote risk RUL-3 accepts). The supervisor's 32768 MB ceiling is more than 10 times the largest measured closure resident set (3.1 GB at N = 40, synthetic proxy), so it does not bind in the design range. The kill-inside-child path of RUL-3(a) is therefore untested, not contradicted.
